question: after W984 made every clause real, is gft_smul's failure GONE or merely ABSENT at the one placement W984 tried?
method: tri seeds -- one netlist, four placements per design, each read bracketed by a wrong-part bitstream forcing Done=0
result: 8 of 8 PASS. Identical words in every build. The split verdict that defined W842, W977, W981, W982 and W983 does not reproduce on the repaired sources.
what_cannot_be_concluded: that place-and-route is now function-preserving. The repair grew the designs by 43 % (smul, 1312 -> 1877 LUT) and 121 % (dup, 798 -> 1763 LUT), so 'the failure is gone' and 'the failure is absent in a design this different' are not separated by this sweep and cannot be separated by any future one -- the case that failed no longer exists.
the_loss: this project's only reproducible hardware anomaly was carried by the folded wrappers. Repairing them was right and it destroyed the reproducer.

mitigation.why: kept OUT of the corpus and out of the clause gate, as the regression case for the openXC7 report. Marked do-not-fix.

a_hypothesis_this_raises: in the folded wrappers the COMM clause compared two cones each specialised on a literal operand; with Z0 neither operand is a literal, both cones are the generic multiplier, and they agree. W982 proved the folded cones logically equivalent (tri miter, 277 cells, no counterexample), so a pure logic difference is excluded -- but a placement sensitivity peculiar to the small specialised cones is not.

environment.disk: 0.37 GiB at the sweep's end; t27-silicon cleared to 0.45 GiB
